review.notes: Full review at the same head as r14 (empty change set); README read in full (2590 lines), Suggested.lean in full. Gate re-run: every count 0, OK (worker's run build=0). Depcheck: 239 roadmaps, 2336 edges, 0 problems, no UPWARD/CYCLE/moved line. Nothing outside the folder. lake env lean exits 0 with exactly 14 sorry warnings; #check @ audit of all 33 declarations, no dropped binder (hbesselK leads false positives); one-tactic probe leaves goals on all 14. Instances: GL and Fx use Units.instMeasurableSpace (comap val), so Haar hypotheses are not vacuous. Seeded sample (Check for the theta-Mellin formula, AL.3.5.1) verified against CogdellColumbia lines 256-289, pp.4-5: 60 vs 30. ~45 Mathlib names #checked, 14 Tau Ceti names located; supplier citations resolved at open heads (ANT-I besselK = hbesselK body, so rfl holds; ANT-II 5.3g/h/j; AGR 2.4/2.5/2.7 anchors and names; SR 1.1/2.3/5.1/5.3; CFT layer 7 both characteristics; ECF 0.11; IG.0.T3). Bessel identities checked numerically (0.166597 both sides; 0.03091 quadrature vs 0.030923). Findings, all P3: R01 AL.0.1.11/AL.0.1.4 negative-control Checks use non-compact instances and the AL.0.1.11 claim 'continuity cannot replace local constancy' is false (tube lemma + no small subgroups); R02 'rank-one theorem is the case n = 0' of godementJacquetLocal is not literally true (sharp half-planes vs existential c); R03 AL.3.9.4 cites Cogdell Lecture 9 sec. 5 for completed-tensor estimates the text says are unwritten (lines 3373-3382); R04 AL.4.2.1 Needs names two non-targets; R05 'c(pi)=1' notation clash in AL.1.3.5; R06 PR description still contradicts README (carried from r14, description-only). FunctionFieldArithmetic (#1474, later) restates AL.0.6.1's self-dual volume comparison: repair belongs to that roadmap.
